behaviors.selection: Invoked by the tracked WaterSystem application and its presentation/query consumers.

checks.expectation: The retained operation declares each cross-System data route.

Retain parcel gravity, drag, neighbour cohesion/viscosity, three separation passes, speed bounds, interaction samples and impact records. Continuous source volumes and supported rest/wake replace world-block ownership, lattice constraints and settled-block conversion. Swept contact uses immutable accepted terrain/soil and shared trough triangles without acquiring the soil-owned OGC context.
checks.procedure: Check mass/identity ledger across emit/rest/wake/recycle/disable; untouched supported water rests, contact revision/disturbance wakes it. Check thin/sloped/overhanging triangle contact, trough bottom/walls, no tunnelling, no crossing unknown coverage and no block conversion. Check bounded timestep/substeps and capacity. Preserve the force coefficients; measure numerical and performance behavior rather than claim native OGC ownership.
